name: Ulam OPDP Difficulty Atlas
author: Alejandro Zarzuelo Urdiales

licenses.MathDB: CC BY 4.0 declared database content (https://mathdb.com/terms); records are public-list excerpts, not complete statements
licenses.ProofAtlas: see the atlas NOTICE.md and OPDP_v1.8_PROOFATLAS_APPEND_NOTES.md

import_rules: numeric problem_id is the key; problem_number is a display id and is not unique
intrinsic tiers T1-T5 and tractability bands T0-T10 are separate namespaces
null is not zero: tractability.score is null for solved or ill-posed records
catalog_status and assessment_gate stay visible; a score does not certify openness
MathDB records carry source_text.text_mode = mathdb_public_list_excerpt and must be completed from their cited source before formalization; never bulk-fetch MathDB detail pages past its terms
